decisions.reason: Acceptance of bulkiness caused by the solenoid and piping does not remove the separate constraint that bowl wells should not make the enclosure overly large.
The accepted enclosure bulk and button location do not change any splash-control behavior or mitigation.
The logo discussion concerns the support-base design, not the machine placard text, position, or viewing orientations.
The source does not change the beige and green color scheme or the support-base colors.
A bulkier enclosure does not alter the requirement that the unit remain stable and resist rattling or shifting.
The source does not change the off-the-shelf component strategy for the initial prototype.
Acceptance of the current enclosure bulk and button placement does not change mixing, frothing, whisk, or foam-performance requirements.
The platform must still match the machine footprint, but accepting the current machine bulk does not change that relational requirement or its specified height and cup clearance.
The source accepts the location of the spout control buttons but does not change spout mounting, material, orientation, appearance, or pour direction.
The candidate is already in CLARIFY because the client is considering another logo; message 155 merely confirms that exploration remains unresolved and does not establish a new design.
The client explicitly decides to retain the current location of the spout on/off buttons, adding a placement constraint to the button-actuated dispensing controls.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I’m okay with the on/off buttons staying in their current location, and I’m also comfortable with the machine being bulkier.

I’ll work on another logo this weekend. I don’t dislike the current one; I just want to see whether I can create something better.

value_updates.spout_button_location: retain the spout on/off buttons in their current location

decisions.reason: Acceptance of the assembled machine's bulk and control placement does not revise the finalized BOM or its component selections.
